title: One-bit supremum norm bound
statement: Let $a,b\in\mathbb R$. The supremum of $|a+0\cdot b\varepsilon|$ over signs $\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}$ is at most the $2$-norm of $a+b\varepsilon$ for a uniformly chosen sign.
